title: Austria skilled-employment pathway discovery

persona.instruction: Do not tell the system which pathway to select. Supply only the persona facts captured by the tester and let the governed pathway workflow determine candidates from reviewed evidence.

objectives: Run the Truth Engine and pathway workflow end to end without pre-selecting the answer.
Confirm that every material immigration rule used by the result is traceable to reviewed official-source evidence.
Confirm that uncertainty and missing facts are explicit rather than converted into unsupported legal certainty.
Confirm that critical document requirements are not silently omitted.
Measure whether a real mobility user understands the recommendation and whether a professional/operator considers it operationally useful.
Record founder intervention count for the ordinary workflow.
